title: Setup and approach
author: claude
summary: Why the project exists, the rules it follows, and how the lab was set up.
what: The first decisions: what we are trying to achieve, the rules we must keep, and the separate lab app we work in.
why: Getting the goal and the rules clear first keeps all later work pointed in one direction.
how: Three steps: write down the goal and rules, create the lab app, and save it in git for the first time.
